notes: «كلاهما عن سفيان» and the dashed gloss «قال أبو بكر حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة» name the same man; the fuller form is written once (rule 7)
The dashed clause is Muslim's own remark, and the chain then runs on through «حدثنا عمرو بن دينار»
Ibn Abbas heard the Prophet, so he is the last link (rule 6)
